PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool
